title: Monotonicity-based regularization of inverse medium scattering for shape reconstruction
summary: We consider the scattering of time-harmonic plane waves by a compactly supported inhomogeneous scattering obstacle governed by the Helmholtz equation. Given far field observations of the scattered fields corresponding to plane wave incident fields for all possible incident and observation directions we study the inverse problem to recover the support of the scatterer.
